claim_being_audited: That certifying the model for launch is policy-compliant and evidentially supportable despite a known field-service dispatch weakness, because aggregate readiness passed, launch is limited to 6% with rollback and monitoring, and the limitation can be handled through explicit disclosure in the audit packet.
decision_criteria: Use `compliant` only if admissible evidence shows the policy threshold is met, including any required disclosure, exclusion, or approved risk acceptance.
Use `suspicious` if the certification case is plausible in part but a required support link or policy predicate remains unresolved.
Treat aggregate readiness, limited rollout, rollback, and monitoring as relevant context but not substitutes for exclusion of the affected use case or approved risk acceptance.
Do not treat general public AI-governance guidance as sufficient to satisfy the repo-specific release policy.
evidence_requests: Final approved model card or launch packet showing the field-service dispatch limitation is expressly disclosed for this named launch use case.
Reviewed and signed risk acceptance that specifically addresses continued exposure of the field-service dispatch segment, if disclosure alone is not the intended control.
Evidence that the initial rollout cohort excludes the affected field-service dispatch segment, if that is being claimed as the mitigation path.
The exact certification criterion or release gate showing whether disclosure alone is sufficient for launch when a material limitation remains unresolved.
specific_concerns: The affected field-service dispatch use case remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The available risk-acceptance document is only a draft, has no approver, and does not address the exposed field-service dispatch segment.

The governing policy says rollout controls and monitoring mitigate a material weakness only if the affected use case is excluded or there is reviewed risk acceptance explaining why exposure is acceptable.
There is no admissible evidence that the required model-card disclosure has actually been completed for this launch packet.
Public guidance on monitoring and model-card content is general and does not override the specific release-policy predicate.
unsupported_claims: That certification is already evidentially justified by rollout controls and monitoring despite the exposed segment.
That explicit disclosure will occur before launch; the record contains policy requiring disclosure, not evidence that disclosure has been made.
That the current record satisfies the policy threshold for using rollout controls as mitigation when the affected use case remains exposed.
